value.rationale: Robust house monotonicity is a natural election criterion, and tie-independent minimal electorate is a meaningful invariant. The theorem supplies the exact first-failure point, fully classifies extremizers, and shows even voter-interval structure and concave value functions do not entail nested optimal committees. This goes beyond reproducing Janson’s already-known qualitative counterexample.
